methods.name: VARMA(p, q) by the Hannan-Rissanen two-step estimator (long VAR by OLS, then OLS on lagged y and lagged long-VAR residuals)
methods.reference: Hannan & Rissanen (1982) written out in R (no VARMA package installed: MTS, marima, dse); each OLS step stats::lm.fit / stats::lm with summary.lm SEs and p-values for q = 0; q = 0 against vars::VAR(type = 'const'), logLik.varest, AIC, BIC; default long-VAR order max(floor(log(n)^2), 2 max(p, q)) (Gomez & Maravall 2001) reduced to floor((n - 2) / (2K + 1))
quantities: constant, AR and MA coefficients per equation
standard errors and p-values (q = 0 only; not reported for q > 0)
long-VAR order (default rule and its reduction)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md: n_eff 364-399 coefficients 1e-8, SEs (q = 0), statistics, Sigma_u and logLik/AIC/BIC 1e-6, p-values (q = 0) 1e-6 relative + 1e-12 absolute; short60 (n_eff 48) coefficients 1e-6, statistics 1e-5; orders and counts exact
